missed_day: Hey, you weren't here yesterday! I ended up sparring with a rock. The rock lost, but still.
Missed a day? That's okay! It just means today's gonna feel extra good.
Aw, I saved you a spot and everything. Come on, let's make up for it!
You know what's great about a skipped workout? You're really well rested for this one.
Yesterday's gone. I can't even remember what I had for breakfast yesterday. Let's go!
I get it, some days your body says no. Today we ask it again, nicely.
No training yesterday? Your muscles are probably bored. Let's fix that.
Don't beat yourself up. Save the beating for the training dummy!
Ah, you missed one. I do that with naps sometimes. Then I train double!
Hey, no worries. Let's just go a little harder today, okay?
You missed a day? My stomach never misses a meal. Let's treat training like dinner!
Yesterday doesn't count, but today does! Come on, warm up with me.
Even I lose sometimes. The fun part is the rematch!
Huh, quiet day yesterday. Let's make some noise today!
A day off is fine. Two days off and I start getting antsy for you.
Shake it off! Like water after a swim. Ready? Go!
comeback: You're back! I knew it! Okay, okay, where were we?
See? You didn't lose anything. It's all still in there. Feel that?
Ha! That's what I like to see. Getting knocked down just means a running start.
Yes! Welcome back! I was about to come drag you out here myself.
One day off and you came back hungrier. That's a fighter's instinct.
Look at you go! Yesterday who? Never heard of it.
That first one back is the hardest. And you just did it. Wanna do another?
This is my favourite part: when you show up even though it'd be easy not to.
Hey hey, you're back! I tried doing your training without you. It was boring.
Alright! Let's pick up right where we left off. Maybe a little further.
You came back! That's what makes someone really strong, you know.
Woo! Back in action! I can feel your energy from here.
Welcome back! Did you eat? Let's eat. Then train. Okay, train first.
That's it! Every time you come back, you come back stronger.
There you are! Let's do something fun. Like push-ups. Lots of them.
Missed you! Training's way better with a partner.
streak_milestone: {streak} days in a row! Whoa! You're getting stronger so fast it's making me excited!
{streak} days! Can you feel it? You couldn't have done today's training back at the start.
A {streak}-day streak! Okay, now I really want to spar with you.
Wow, {streak} already? Time flies when you're having fun getting sore.
{streak} straight! You know what that calls for? A huge meal. Then more training.
{streak} days and you're not even slowing down. I love this!
{streak}! Keep going! I wanna see how far this goes just as much as you do.
{streak} days! Your power's going up, I can feel it!
Whoa, {streak} days! That's longer than I've ever sat still for anything!
{streak} days straight! Let's celebrate with... more training!
{streak} days! If you keep this up, I'm gonna need a stronger sparring partner. Oh wait, that's you!
{streak} days in a row and you're still smiling? Awesome.
Hey, {streak} days! That's a lot of days! I think. I'm bad at counting.
{streak} days! You know what comes next? The day after that!
A {streak}-day streak! Man, I wish I could fight you right now.
boss_defeated: You beat {boss}! That was awesome! Did you see the look on that face?
{boss} was really strong, huh? That's the best kind to beat.
Ha ha! {boss} is down! Man, now I'm all fired up. Who's next?
You did it! I knew you would, but watching it was way better.
{boss}, done! You kept hitting till it was over. Nothing fancy. Perfect.
That was a great fight! I almost jumped in, but it was yours to win.
Beating {boss} means there's somebody even stronger out there. Isn't that exciting?
Victory! Let's eat! Then let's find something harder!
{boss} didn't know what hit them! Well, it was you. Every single day.
You took down {boss}! Let's go find somebody even stronger!
That was so cool! You beat {boss} without giving up once.
{boss} is beaten! Bet you're starving. I know I am.
Hey, {boss} wasn't so tough after all. Or you just got really strong!
Yes! {boss} is down! I'm so proud I could fly. Wait, I can fly.
Beating {boss} was awesome, but watching you get there was even better.
Down goes {boss}! The next one's gonna be even stronger. Can't wait!
idle: Morning! Great day for training. They all are, though.
Hey, let's do one more than yesterday. Just one!
I'm so hungry. Let's train first, though. Food tastes better after.
The best part of getting strong is there's always a next level.
You don't have to win today. You just have to show up and try hard.
Ready? I've been ready since sunrise. I couldn't sleep, I was too excited.
Tired's okay. Tired means it's working!
Come on, come on! Daylight's burning and I've got energy to spare.
Let's see how strong you are today! Bet it's a little stronger than yesterday.
Stretch first! I learned that one the hard way.
Every little bit adds up. That's how I got strong. Plus a lot of food.
Hey, wanna train? Of course you do. Let's go!
Whatever you're doing today, put your whole heart in it!
Don't worry about being the strongest. Just be stronger than last week!
You know what's great? Today's a brand new day to get better.
I'm feeling good today! You too? Let's put it to use!

evening: Hey! There's still training left today! Let's finish strong!
Before dinner... okay, after dinner. One more session?
The day's not over yet! We can still get it done!
Come on, just a bit more! Then we can rest.
You've got stuff left today. I'll cheer you on!
Last round of the day! Let's go!
It's getting late, but I've still got energy. You too?
Don't go to bed yet! There's still training to finish!
game: Okay, okay, hold it, then let go! Big cast, big fish!
Don't pull too hard, you'll snap it! Easy, easy...
Ha, I usually just jump in. But this is fun too!
Patience! That's the hard part. For me, anyway.
The river's full of them today. I can feel it!
Reel when it rests, let go when it runs!
game_done: Whoa! Look at that one! We're eating good tonight!
Nice catch! Wanna go again? I wanna go again.
That's a big one! Well, for you. I once caught one bigger than a house.
Yes! Fishing is the best training. Don't tell Piccolo.
Ha! It put up a fight, huh? You did great.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The sun is barely up. Goku has already been training for an hour. He waves you over with both arms.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Hey! Perfect timing! Squats! Let's go!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Fifty squats later, your legs are burning.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Okay, that's the set! ...Wanna do one more?

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: You said that was the last one.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: It was! This is a new last one.

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: Sure it is! Last just means the one before the next one.

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: Yes! I knew you would!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: You do one more. Then he says it again. You do another.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: The one after you wanted to stop is the one that counts. It's my favourite.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Why that one?

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Because all the other ones, you were going to do anyway. That one's the one where you decided.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Your body says 'stop', and you go 'nah, one more', and then your body goes 'oh, okay, I guess I can'. That's how it learns!

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: That's surprisingly deep.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Ha! Don't tell anyone. They think I only know about food.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: ...Speaking of which. Breakfast?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Goku is on his ninth bowl of rice. There's a tower of empty plates next to him that's taller than you.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: How can you train after eating that much?

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: How can you train without it? You've gotta put something in to get something out!

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: Less? Why? You're training! Your body's building stuff! It needs bricks!

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: I mean, maybe less of the junk. Bulma says that's the important bit. But less food overall? No way.

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: Real food! Rice, fish, vegetables, eggs. Stuff that grew or swam. Grandpa always said, if you can't tell what it used to be, eat less of it.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Eat big, sleep big, train big. It's not complicated. People just make it complicated.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Some people would say you overdo the 'eat big' part.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Ha! Chi-Chi says that every day. But I train really hard, so it balances.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He finishes the ninth bowl and looks sadly at the empty pot.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: You know the best thing about eating properly? You feel good all day. No crashing at lunchtime, no getting grumpy.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Vegeta skips meals sometimes because he's too busy training. He's always grumpy. Coincidence? I don't think so!

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: I think Vegeta might be grumpy anyway.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: ...Okay, yeah, that's true. But it doesn't help!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: You've just lost a sparring match against one of Roshi's old students. Badly. You're sitting in the sand.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Hey. You okay?

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Have you ever lost a fight?

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Oh, tons! Some really bad ones.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Really? You?

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: When I was a kid I lost to a guy who cheated, a guy who was way bigger, a guy who was way smaller, and once to a really fast cat.

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: It was a really fast cat.

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: Badly, at first! I sulked. Then I got hungry and forgot to sulk.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: But every time, I found out exactly what I was missing. You can't buy that anywhere.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Like, the fast cat taught me I was terrible at dodging. So I practised dodging for a month. Then I beat the cat.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: You had a rematch with a cat?

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: A friendly rematch! It was fine! It got fish after.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Win and you feel good. Lose and you get a to-do list. Both are pretty great.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: So what's on my to-do list?

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: You kept looking at his hands instead of his shoulders. Shoulders move first. Let's practise!

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Hey! Let's spar. For real this time.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: I can't beat you.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: So? I'm not asking you to beat me. I'm asking you to try as hard as you can and see what happens.

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: I'll be careful! I'm really good at not hurting people. Mostly. I'll be extra careful.

choice.text: Okay. Don't hold back too much.

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: Ha! I like that! I'll hold back exactly the right amount.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: You take your stance. He takes his, grinning like it's his birthday.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: You last eleven seconds. Goku is delighted.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Eleven! Last month you wouldn't have seen the first one coming.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: I didn't see the last one coming either.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Yeah, but you saw the second one! And the third! You even blocked one! I felt it!

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: That's the thing. It's not about winning. It's about the bit you got right this time that you got wrong last time.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Eleven seconds of getting things right.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Eleven seconds of getting better! Next month, fifteen. Then thirty.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He helps you up. His hand is warm and the grip is gentle.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Next real fight you're in, I've got your back.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: There's this thing I do when I really need it. Push everything to double for a little while.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He demonstrates. A red glow wraps around him and the sand blows outward in a ring. Then it's gone, and he's panting.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Why not do it all the time?

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Ha, because it wrecks you! You get one big day, then you pay for it.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: My whole body aches for ages after. If I did it every day, I'd break.

choice.text: So when do you use it?

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: When it really, really matters. A big fight. A day where everything's on the line.

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: Ha! Bulma says that too! Yeah, exactly like that. Works once. Hurts after.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: So pick the day. That's the whole trick. I'll show you.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: You've got your normal days. Steady, every day. Then once in a while, a big day where you go double.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: But you can only go double because the normal days built you up. No normal days, no double.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: So the steady days are what make the big days possible.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Yeah! You get it! Most people try to do the big day every day and then they're broken by Wednesday.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Okay. Next time there's something huge, you call me. We'll pick the day together.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Late afternoon. Goku is floating on his back in the sea, doing nothing for once.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Why do you train so hard? You're already the strongest person I know.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Hm. I never really thought about it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He floats for a while. A seagull lands on his stomach. He doesn't seem to mind.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: I guess I just like finding out what I can do. And then it turns out I can do a bit more.

choice.text: But don't you ever want to stop?

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: Stop? Like, forever? That sounds so boring!

choice.text: Is it about being the best?

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: Nah. If someone's better than me, that's great! It means I get to fight someone better than me!

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: If I stopped, I'd never know what the next one felt like. That'd bug me forever.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: The next level?

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: The next anything. The next technique, the next place, the next really good meal.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Why do you train?

choice.text: To be someone I'm proud of.

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: That's a really good one! Way better than mine. Mine's just 'because it's fun'.

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: That's okay! Keep training while you figure it out. The answer usually shows up mid-push-up.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The seagull flies away. Goku sinks slightly, then remembers to swim.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Goku is sitting on a rock, unusually still. No food in his hand. That's how you know something's wrong.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Are you alright?

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Yeah. Training went badly today. Everything felt heavy.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: You have bad days too?

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Course! I'm not a robot. Bulma's built robots. They don't have bad days. I do.

choice.text: What do you do on them?

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: I just do the easy version on those days, so the streak in my head doesn't break.

choice.text: Do you want to talk about it?

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: Nah. It's nothing specific. Sometimes your body just says 'not today'. I listen a little bit, but not all the way.

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: I do the easy version, so the streak in my head doesn't break.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Like, today I was supposed to do a thousand push-ups. I did a hundred. Really slowly. Then I sat here.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: A hundred is still a lot.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Right? That's what I'm telling myself! It's not zero. Zero's the only one that doesn't count.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: A bad workout still counts. Don't tell Vegeta I said that.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: He'd say 'a bad workout is a coward's workout' or something. He says stuff like that. Then he'd do a bad workout on his bad day and pretend he didn't.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He stands up and stretches.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Okay. Feeling better. Wanna get food?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Night. Goku is lying in the grass looking at the stars.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: The biggest thing I can do, I can't do alone. I have to ask for a little energy from everybody.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: And they just give it?

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Mostly! People want to help, if you ask and it's for something that matters.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: I raise my hands, and everyone, all over, lends me a tiny bit. The trees, the animals, people in towns I've never been to.

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: It is! It's the strongest thing I know. And none of it's really mine.

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: Then it doesn't work. That's the scary part. I have to trust people.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: All those tiny bits add up to something huge. Kinda like your training, huh?

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Every little check-off.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Yeah! Each one's a tiny bit of energy. On its own, nothing. All together? Boom!

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Also, you've got all of us. Roshi, Piccolo, Bulma, me. Even Vegeta, though he'd never say it.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: If you're ever trying something really big, ask. That's not weak. That's the smartest thing you can do.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A shooting star crosses the sky. Goku points at it, delighted, like he's never seen one before.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: Hey, I've been meaning to say. You're not really my student any more.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Did I do something wrong?

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: No way! It's just, students follow. You've been keeping up.

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: Barely is still keeping up! Most people don't even get to barely!

then.speaker: GOKU
then.text: A training partner! That's way better. Students are fun, but partners push you back.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: When we did the hill sprints yesterday, I had to actually try. Like, really try. You were right behind me.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: You were carrying a boulder.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: A small boulder! And I still had to try!

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: So I'm gonna train extra hard now. I don't wanna get left behind!

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: You're not going to get left behind.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: You don't know that! You're getting stronger every day! That's the most exciting thing ever!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He's grinning so wide it looks like it hurts.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: This is the best part, you know. When someone you trained starts pushing you. It means it worked.

lines.speaker: GOKU
lines.text: ...One more?
